subject: Marine Works - Northumberland Strait - Wallace
text:
Marine Works - Northumberland Strait - Wallace
Construction of new crib structure at Wallace wharf starting 28 June 2026 during daylight hours only. During this time, the wharf will be unavailable for use.
Two marker buoys will be deployed with flashing yellow lights. Silt booms will be in place.
Multiple vessels will be on scene.
Minimum wash and a wide berth are requested.
